name: Mana Crystal [Recovery]
forceChain: Heals all allies [1 HIT / 100%] at Attack Power [3735].
autoCondition: Activates when an ally is at 50% HP or less.

name: Passion Mana Crystal [Resurrection]
forceChain: Revives 1 random ally and heals all allies [1 HIT / 100%] at Attack Power [12825].
forceChainAdditionalEffect: Requires an ally holding Crest: Passion level 5 or higher in the chain. Heals all allies [1 HIT / 150%] using the combined Attack Power of the qualifying participants.
autoCondition: Activates when an ally is at 50% HP or less.

name: Impact Mana Crystal [Dispel]
forceChain: Heals all allies [1 HIT / 100%] at Attack Power [12825] and removes 1 random status ailment from all allies.
forceChainAdditionalEffect: Requires an ally holding Crest: Impact level 5 or higher in the chain. Removes status ailments from all allies equal to the number of qualifying participants.
autoCondition: Activates when an ally is at 50% HP or less, or when an ally has a status ailment.

name: Passion Mana Crystal [Vigor]
forceChain: Grants all allies Attack UP [21% / 25 seconds] and Defense UP [21% / 25 seconds].
forceChainAdditionalEffect: Requires an ally holding Crest: Passion level 5 or higher in the chain. Grants all allies CRIT Damage Multiplier UP [qualifying participants x 5% / 25 seconds].
autoCondition: Activates when current Mana is 8 or more.

name: Mana Crystal [Destruction]
forceChain: Deals [1 HIT / 100%] damage to all enemies at Attack Power [3725].
autoCondition: Activates when there are 3 or more enemies.

name: Passion Mana Crystal [Strength]
forceChain: Grants all allies Attack Power UP [39% / 25 seconds].
forceChainAdditionalEffect: Requires an ally holding Crest: Passion level 5 or higher in the chain. Grants all allies Damage Dealt UP [qualifying participants x 10% / 25 seconds].
autoCondition: Activates when current Mana is 7 or more.

name: Impact Mana Crystal [Gale]
forceChain: Deals [1 HIT / 100%] damage to all enemies at Attack Power [8550] and inflicts Knockback Lv6 on all enemies.
forceChainAdditionalEffect: Requires an ally holding Crest: Impact level 5 or higher in the chain. Deals [1 HIT / 125%] damage to all enemies using the combined Attack Power of the qualifying participants, and grants all allies Multi-Hit Rate UP [50% / 15 seconds].
autoCondition: Activates when there are 3 or more enemies.

name: Mana Crystal [Adamant]
forceChain: Grants all allies Defense UP [52% / 15 seconds].
autoCondition: Activates when an enemy enters Assault Mode.

name: Passion Mana Crystal [Collapse]
forceChain: Deals [1 HIT / 100%] damage to all enemies at Attack Power [10687] and inflicts Defense DOWN [20% / 20 seconds] on all enemies.
forceChainAdditionalEffect: Requires an ally holding Crest: Passion level 5 or higher in the chain. Increases the Defense DOWN effect by [qualifying participants x 7.5%].
autoCondition: Activates when current Mana is 8 or more.

name: Impact Mana Crystal [Poison]
forceChain: Deals [1 HIT / 100%] damage to all enemies at Attack Power [10687] and inflicts Poison [30 seconds] on all enemies.
forceChainAdditionalEffect: Requires an ally holding Crest: Impact level 5 or higher in the chain. Increases Poison damage by the number of qualifying participants, and inflicts Attack DOWN [20% / 20 seconds] on all enemies.
autoCondition: Activates when current Mana is 7 or more.

name: Impact Mana Crystal [Void]
forceChain: Deals [6 HIT / Total 100%] damage to all enemies at Attack Power [12825] and inflicts Damage Taken UP [20% / 25 seconds] on all enemies.
forceChainAdditionalEffect: Requires an ally holding Crest: Impact level 5 or higher in the chain. Increases the Damage Taken UP effect by [qualifying participants x 10%].
autoCondition: Activates when current Mana is 8 or more.
